summary: Oruka Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing a first amendment to its IL-23 license agreement with Paragon Therapeutics. The amendment expands the licensed field to include inflammatory bowel disease, with dosing restrictions on ORKA-001: no combination dosing before June 2028 and no monotherapy dosing before June 2030. No financial terms, change of control, or material transaction are disclosed. This is a routine contractual modification, not a special situation.
